```{r}
library(ggplot2)

```

```{r}
# omics_df <- read.csv("../preprocessed_data/omics_aibl_demo_imputed.csv")
omics_df <- read.csv("../preprocessed_data/omics_aibl_demo_clean_imputed.csv")
```


```{r}
library(tableone)
library(dplyr)

continuous_vars <- c("Age", 
                     "Demographic.Years.of.Education.Exact",  # Education in years
                     "Centiloid")  

categorical_vars <- c("APOE4", "label")  

all_vars <- c(continuous_vars, categorical_vars)

# Specify which continuous variables are non-normal (will use median [IQR] instead of mean (SD))
# and will use Mann-Whitney U test instead of t-test
nonnormal_vars <- c("Centiloid")  # Add variables that are not normally distributed

table1 <- CreateTableOne(
  vars = all_vars,
  strata = "Demographic.Sex", 
  data = omics_df,
  factorVars = categorical_vars,
  test = TRUE,
  addOverall = TRUE
)

print(table1, 
      nonnormal = nonnormal_vars,
      exact = categorical_vars,  # Use Fisher's exact test for categorical variables
      smd = FALSE,  # Don't show standardized mean differences
      showAllLevels = FALSE,  # Don't show all levels of categorical variables
      cramVars = NULL,
      contDigits = 1,  # 1 decimal place for continuous variables
      catDigits = 1,   # 1 decimal place for percentages
      pDigits = 3,     # 3 decimal places for p-values
      quote = FALSE,
      noSpaces = TRUE,
      printToggle = TRUE)

table1_export <- print(table1, 
                       nonnormal = nonnormal_vars,
                       exact = categorical_vars,
                       smd = FALSE,
                       showAllLevels = FALSE,
                       quote = FALSE,
                       noSpaces = TRUE,
                       printToggle = FALSE)
```
